notes.title: Announcing: RISU
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40087787/6314280275629ab00ec1903d89694c6150739691.png[/img]

Hello! I'm Ryan, this is my first game to be on Steam and I'm super excited to finally be sharing it!

Risu is a dark psychological horror game that follows in the footsteps of Clock Tower and Silent Hill (and hopefully will have plenty of new stuff to surprise you). It takes place in Tokyo during the early 2000s and follows the eponymous Risu Ishikawa as she deals with the grief of losing her mother.

I'm collaborating with some great people to make this, primarily being KFC Murder Chicks for the soundtrack! If you don't know their work you can check it out here:
[url=https://kfcmurderchicks.bandcamp.com/]https://kfcmurderchicks.bandcamp.com/[/url]
